Earnings.description: Announcements or releases of quarterly or annual financial results, including revenue, profit, or loss, and earnings guidance.

M&A.description: Corporate transactions including mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, buyouts, or joint ventures.

Product Launch.description: Introduction or release of new products, services, platforms, or features or technologies.

Strategic Partnerships.description: Collaborations or alliances between companies for technology, distribution, co-development, or market access.

Regulatory / Legal.description: Regulatory approvals, government investigations, fines, legal rulings, or compliance-related events.

Workforce Changes.description: Employee-related events including layoffs, hiring, furloughs, or other workforce restructuring.

Leadership Changes.description: Appointments, resignations, or departures of executive leadership or board members.

Supply Chain / Operations.description: Operational or supply chain-related events such as plant openings, shutdowns, disruptions, or production changes.

Restructuring.description: Corporate restructuring, cost-cutting measures, or organizational realignment initiatives.

Funding.description: Capital raising events including venture funding, private equity, debt issuance, or IPOs.

ESG.description: Environmental, social, or governance initiatives, sustainability efforts, or related corporate announcements.
